contract_feature_acceptance.blocked: formal matched labels/provider values are insufficient or fail integrity/coverage gates
contract_feature_acceptance.not_supported: no meaningful incremental improvement or consistent degradation
contract_feature_acceptance.partial: measurable but target-specific/small improvement, OOD-stratum sensitivity, or unstable q95/worst-case behavior
contract_feature_acceptance.production_H1_is_separate: all frozen conjunctive H1 gates must pass; feature utility never implies production admission
contract_feature_acceptance.supported: at least one legal NP arm improves both state and routing median RMSE by >=5%, wins on >=60% of geometries for both endpoints (12/20 for 20G; 20/32 for 32G), and does not worsen state/routing q95 by >10% or worst-case error by >25%; key absolute-order and total-power medians/q95 must not materially degrade; report OOD strata and seed stability

fold_rule: strict LOGO by complete ordered geometry; three GroupKFold geometry splits within each outer training set
